# Tooltip

A description on hover and focus, plus the toggletip for touch.

In `library/components/tooltip/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

## ARIA

- **the trigger** — `aria-describedby`
- **a trigger with no text of its own** — `aria-labelledby`
- **the bubble** — `role=tooltip` `hidden`

## Keyboard

- `Escape` — dismisses, and the dismissal is remembered until focus or the pointer moves

**States:** shown, hidden, dismissed

## Goes wrong when

- hover only, which fails all three of dismissible, hoverable and persistent (SC 1.4.13)
- pointer-events:none on the bubble, the usual hoverable failure
- aria-describedby toggled with visibility, taking the text from the people who rely on it
- a tap leaving a bubble stuck open — filter on pointerType === 'touch'
- interactive content inside the bubble, which nothing can reach
- essential information only in a tooltip, which touch users often cannot summon

## API

- `AC.createTooltip(root, options) -> { show, hide, isOpen, trigger, tip, destroy }`
- `AC.createToggletip(root, options)`

WCAG 1.3.1 1.4.10 1.4.13 2.1.1 2.1.2 2.4.7 2.5.8 3.3.2 4.1.2 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tooltip/) · see also `icon-button`, `disclosure`, `live-region`
